articles.summary: Yes, Ohio Medicaid can pay you to care for your spouse. Two conditions must be met. Here's how it works under PASSPORT, MyCare Ohio, SFC, and other waivers.
articles.title: Can You Get Paid to Care for Your Spouse in Ohio?

articles.summary: Deciding to become a paid caregiver for a loved one is a huge life shift. Because it sounds like a "hack," many families worry it’s too good to be true. Let’s clear the air and look at the actual facts for 2026.
articles.title: Facts vs Fiction: Caregiver Edition for 2026

articles.summary: Ohio seniors 60+ can get $50 in free vouchers for fresh produce at farmers markets through SFMNP. Enrollment is April 22 – May 22, 2026. Here's how to apply.
articles.title: Free Farmers Market Vouchers for Ohio Seniors: Apply Before May 22, 2026

articles.summary: It usually starts with a phone call. An unexpected fall, a trip to the ER, or a sudden realization that the status-quo is no longer safe. If you’re feeling overwhelmed, you’re not alone. Most families don't "plan" for long-term care; they react to a crisis. The good news? You have more options than just a nursing home. This guide will help you assess your parent’s current safety and navigate the different care models available.
articles.title: My Aging Parent Can’t Live Alone Anymore: A Guide to Every Option
